PGA Tour announces new competition structure and leadership changes

The PGA Tour has announced a revamped competition structure set to begin in 2028, featuring a two-tiered system. Additionally, the tour has appointed three new executives to its leadership team. These changes come as the PGA Tour is not contemplating a path back for LIV Golf players, similar to the situation with Brooks Koepka.
